metadata.title: Vintage Film Burn Boy Band Aesthetic

recipe.visualDefinition: A group portrait of five young men in casual attire, arranged in a tight, multi-level cluster on a green grass surface, characterized by heavy vertical light leaks and a grainy, vintage film texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject proximity creates a sense of unity and intimacy.
Vertical light leaks bisect the frame, adding warmth and movement.
High-angle perspective looks down on the subjects, flattening the space.
Contrast between the organic green grass and the artificial red/orange light flares.
coreInvariants: Analog film grain and dust texture
Desaturated skin tones against vibrant light flares

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects occupy the entire frame in a circular/diamond formation, scaled to fill the space with minimal negative space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure looking directly at the camera, flanked by the vertical orange light leak.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the vertical light leaks from top to bottom, then circulates through the faces of the group members.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; limited to small patches of grass between the subjects.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the light leaks against a muted, low-contrast palette for the subjects and background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or digital-looking colors; maintain analog warmth.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for all branding elements to maintain a minimalist, modern look.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, clean aesthetic of the original.
Provides the necessary weight and modern feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-angle photo of five young men in white and black t-shirts lying and sitting on green grass. Apply heavy vertical orange and red light leaks and a grainy film texture with dust specks.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a three-line stacked uppercase geometric sans-serif title in solid white at the top center, using tight leading and tracking.

verificationChecks: Are the light leaks vertical and vibrant?
Is the film grain visible across the entire image?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects in the group
Color of the light leaks (e.g., blue vs orange)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Any specific brand logos on clothing
The exact wording of the text
postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic skin tones under the light leaks.
Ensure the text is legible against the background.
Verify the texture doesn't obscure the subjects' faces.
Confirm the vertical light leaks feel integrated, not just overlaid.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-angle group portrait on an organic texture with vertical analog light leaks and stacked, bold, geometric sans-serif typography for a nostalgic yet modern music aesthetic.
